capabilities: Check title and body length against platform limits
Flag placeholders, unsupported syntax, and local images
Insert and update per-platform sign-offs safely
Copy the note as plain text or Markdown
Detect the target platform from properties or folders
extras: Fully offline with a Chinese-only interface. Not yet listed in the community plugin directory (manual install for now). Companion plugins recommended: Ad Compliance Check for advertising-law risk and a dedicated WeChat formatting plugin for styling. Copied text carries no images (upload by hand) and embedded notes are not expanded. Only limits with a source are preset; adding new platforms is not supported yet. Should run on mobile but has only been tested on desktop.
motivation: The tool comes from publishing work the author repeats in client projects.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to check a draft against a Chinese platform's length limits, unsupported syntax, or current sign-off before pasting it in.
summary: Publishing pre-flight checker that validates a note against Chinese platform rules, syncs its sign-off, and copies it as paste-ready text.
